races.name: Join Racing TV Now Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
races.verdict:
MOTAWAARED certainly wasn't winning out of turn at Ayr on Thursday but he's a consistent and in-form performer, which cannot be said about most of these. The follow-up is therefore on the cards, with Pride of Nepal and Mudita heading the opposition.

  1. MOTAWAARED
  2. PRIDE OF NEPAL
  3. MUDITA (IRE)

races.name: British EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
VEGASMILE looked a very uncomplicated 2-y-o when making all here a month ago and in the right hands to go on improving, he can concede 4 lb to Blue Pete, who is promising in his own right upped in trip.

  1. VEGASMILE (IRE)
  2. BLUE PETE (IRE)
  3. DODGEM

races.name: Kick Start Your Career With The SRA Selling Stakes
races.verdict:
POSSESSIVE didn't kick on after a promising winning debut for Karl Burke but new connections are quick to drop him in grade and he's more than capable of winning on these terms. Donna Beauty is the obvious threat assuming she shrugs aside a heavy defeat in a nursery, with Mick's The Boy expected to plug on into a place.

  1. POSSESSIVE
  2. DONNA BEAUTY (IRE)
  3. MICK'S THE BOY (IRE)

races.name: Watch On Racing TV Handicap
races.verdict:
Stablemates SKI ANGEL and Royal Duke have had plenty of success at Musselburgh between them and both arrive in very good order. Marginal preference is for the 6-y-o mare, with Albegone another to consider.

  1. SKI ANGEL
  2. ROYAL DUKE
  3. ALBEGONE

races.name: British Stallion Stud EBF Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
DANDY MAGIC has been in top form for a while now and much better than the result at Ayr on Thursday, she can double her tally. Most of these have lots to prove, but Homestrait should bounce back from a rare blip 2 weeks ago.

  1. DANDY MAGIC (IRE)
  2. HOMESTRAIT (IRE)
  3. CARNIVAL OF LIGHT

races.name: Musselburgh Members Handicap
races.verdict:
KELPIE GREY arrives in good form, looking unfortunate possibly not to have won when meeting trouble over C&D last time, so he gets the vote from his much-reduced mark. He is taken to reverse the placings with Monhammer and Rwenearlytheredad from when the trio met here 12 days ago.

  1. KELPIE GREY
  2. MONHAMMER
  3. RWENEARLYTHEREDAD

races.name: Racing TV Handicap
races.verdict:
NED BROY made his first start over this far on the Flat a winning one at Newcastle and he can build on that effort to score again. The pair of Jim Goldie-trained runners are feared most, with Storm On Jura the pick for second from her reduced mark, ahead of Alpine Sierra.

  1. NED BROY (IRE)
  2. STORM ON JURA
  3. ALPINE SIERRA (IRE)

races.name: Shape Engineering EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
The newcomers look the one's to concentrate on with the well-bred BORN THIS WAY the pick. Amandari represents a yard who does well with their debutants and is next best, with Fort McHenry another to consider.

  1. BORN THIS WAY (IRE)
  2. AMANDARI (IRE)
  3. FORT MCHENRY (IRE)

races.name: British EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
STATUS SYMBOL went off a big price but shaped with plenty of promise on debut and gets the verdict to come out on top second time out. Quintillion showed much improved form last time and rates an obvious danger with further progress likely, with Deira Moon also entitled to be in the mix again.

  1. STATUS SYMBOL
  2. QUINTILLION
  3. DEIRA MOON (IRE)

races.name: AKS Skip Hire Services Handicap
races.verdict:
PACE ATTACK is taken to bounce back returned to all-weather with the drop back in trip another likely plus for Sir Mark Prescott's 3-y-o. Astracornus and Madjid appeal as the main dangers in quite an open race.

  1. PACE ATTACK (IRE)
  2. ASTRACORNUS
  3. MADJID

races.name: Pro Shop At Caister Golf Club Handicap
races.verdict:
DARKEST RED is a reliable sort and a 3 lb rise might not be enough to stop him from following up his Brighton victory 2 weeks ago. Atalanta Mist would have won if not seemingly being spooked late on at Ffos Las last time and has to be on the shortlist, with Jack Langley also arriving here in good heart.

  1. DARKEST RED
  2. ATALANTA MIST
  3. JACK LANGLEY

races.name: QuinnBet Handicap
races.verdict:
KOFFEE AND KALE is on an attractive mark and can double his career tally provided he gets the rub of the green. Zoustar Dreams has had a productive season and should be thereabouts, with Sunlit Sea another to consider.

  1. KOFFEE AND KALE
  2. ZOUSTAR DREAMS
  3. SUNLIT SEA

races.name: First Furnishings Handicap
races.verdict:
METHGAL has been in fine form since joining Dylan Cunha from Ireland and makes most appeal. Veteran Good Earth is also considered after his recent Sandown win, whilst Ribenska was a shade better than the result at Windsor last time and looks on a handy mark.

  1. METHGAL (IRE)
  2. GOOD EARTH (IRE)
  3. RIBENSKA (IRE)

races.name: Moulton Racing Club Handicap
races.verdict:
MERAPI shaped well until the longer trip seemed to stretch her when fourth at Leicester last month and she can get off the mark in a thin race. Abu Royal and Potters Prince both arrive after a couple of good efforts and can complete the 1-2-3.

  1. MERAPI
  2. ABU ROYAL (IRE)
  3. POTTERS PRINCE

races.name: Racing TV EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
Probably not a strong novice and a good chance for SHOWCASING GLORY to strike again after his Newcastle success. Boy Basilica and Al Alami are a couple of appealing newcomers to note in the betting.

  1. SHOWCASING GLORY (IRE)
  2. BOY BASILICA (FR)
  3. AL ALAMI

races.name: Racing TV EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
ALBERICH was well backed and just failed behind Showcasing Glory (runs in the first division at 16.12) on his debut at Newcastle 3 weeks ago. That was a promising start and could improve past the penalised Tredegar Square who was successful first time up here in August. Harpagoside is an interesting newcomer hailing from a stable that has had a fine season with its juveniles.

  1. ALBERICH (IRE)
  2. TREDEGAR SQUARE
  3. HARPAGOSIDE

races.name: Unibet 3 Uniboosts A Day Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
It's taken a while to get RAVISHING back to the track since her debut but that was a promising effort and she's taken to get the better of chief form rivals who have seemingly had their limitations exposed. Oceti has been gelded since last seen in the summer and might be the one to chase Roger Varian's filly home.

  1. RAVISHING (IRE)
  2. OCETI (IRE)
  3. ONE OF THE BOYS (IRE)

races.name: Unibet Supports Safer Gambling Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
WADOODA is taken to make light of her absence and prove too strong for Foxy Night. Gosden stable newcomer Wosta would also very much enter the reckoning should the betting speak in her favour.

  1. WADOODA
  2. FOXY NIGHT (IRE)
  3. WOSTA

races.name: Juddmonte EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
RHYTHM OF MY HEART sets a clear standard on her runner-up efforts and can make it third time lucky. Wolverhampton second Heavenly Parole might be the one to chase her home. Oisin Murphy-ridden debutante Fear The Dark needs monitoring in the betting.

  1. RHYTHM OF MY HEART
  2. HEAVENLY PAROLE
  3. FEAR THE DARK

races.name: Try Unibet's New Smartview Racecards Handicap
races.verdict:
A chance is taken on ORGAN who has a good draw and has been the subject of an interesting trainer change. Fantastic Fox finally got his head back in front last time and remains well treated on anything like his best form on this surface. Yorkshire is also of interest back on all-weather if Billy Loughnane is able to navigate him into a good position from stall 12.

  1. ORGAN
  2. FANTASTIC FOX
  3. YORKSHIRE (IRE)

races.name: Try Unibet's Superboosts Handicap
races.verdict:
TIME TO SPARKLE had a bit to spare last time and can defy the handicapper again and complete a hat-trick. Andrew Balding's Floating Market shaped better than the result on her recent handicap debut and may be the one to give James Keane's filly most to think about.

  1. TIME TO SPARKLE
  2. FLOATING MARKET
  3. THAT DARN CANTOR

races.name: Try Unibet's New Improved Acca Boosts Handicap
races.verdict:
Sole 3-y-o NIFFLER can make it 4 wins in his last 5 starts. Last month's Bath scorer Fram Castle is second choice ahead of Tazaman

  1. NIFFLER (GER)
  2. FRAM CASTLE (IRE)
  3. TAZAMAN

races.name: Unibet More Extra Place Races Handicap
races.verdict:
MACANUDO can extend his good run since blinkered and make it 3 wins in his last 4 starts. Moostar makes obvious appeal off the same mark as when successful over 7f at Leicester last Monday but things may need to drop her way from a wide stall back over shorter, particularly if she's slowly away from the start again. Last month's Windsor second Rory's Royale completes the shortlist.

  1. MACANUDO (IRE)
  2. MOOSTAR
  3. RORY'S ROYALE

races.name: Download The At The Races App Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
A gelding operation may benefit INDHAAR and he's taken to land what looks just an ordinary novice. Once-raced winner Ella Beach can chase the selection home from the well-bred Tropbien.

  1. INDHAAR
  2. ELLA BEACH (FR)
  3. TROPBIEN

races.name: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
SAILOR'S RETURN was unlucky last time and can go one better with the forecast strong pace expected to suit her run style. The in-form Espanita should be thereabouts again, with Maria Da Silva taken to see out the places.

  1. SAILOR'S RETURN
  2. ESPANITA (IRE)
  3. MARIA DA SILVA (IRE)

races.name: Free Tips On attheraces.com EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
GREAT BALLS O'FIRE found the step up to Group company a bit too much, certainly at this stage of his career but he'd impressed when making a winning debut with a bit to spare at Newmarket in August and is fancied to be seen to much better effect back in calmer waters. Val de Grey and Benbecula may emerge as the chief dangers to Richard Spencer's colt.

  1. GREAT BALLS O'FIRE
  2. VAL DE GREY
  3. BENBECULA (IRE)

races.name: Follow AtTheRaces On Instagram Nursery
races.verdict:
STARBURSTER finished fourth in a race that has thrown up winners on debut and she built on that effort following 3 months off when opening her account at Newbury 7 weeks ago. The runner up that day has tasted success twice since and with further progress beckoning, she makes plenty of appeal on nursery debut. Innichen will likely find this less demanding than his latest Doncaster assignment and is a threat, with Minzelle and Siouxperb completing the dangers.

  1. STARBURSTER (IRE)
  2. INNICHEN (ITY)
  3. MINZELLE (IRE)

races.name: Download The Raceday Ready App Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
MAE AMOR has eased a little in the weights and quickly bounced right back to form when finishing second in a C&D handicap 11 days ago, disputing lead late and denied on the bob. Successful from a higher mark in the spring, she looks a big player from a handy draw. Juan Les Pins is another to consider, whilst Kinnalargy requires a market check on debut for David O'Meara. Taygar is also respected.

  1. MAE AMOR (IRE)
  2. JUAN LES PINS
  3. KINNALARGY

races.name: Download The Raceday Ready App Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
Having caught the eye on his penultimate start, EMPEROR CARADOC fully confirmed the promise of that run when getting on top late on over 5f at Redcar 9 days ago. He ought to be highly competitive again on the back of a 4 lb rise with the return to 6f a likely plus. Kats Bob and Fizzy Cristal are others to consider, along with Acclaimed Freedom.

  1. EMPEROR CARADOC (FR)
  2. KATS BOB
  3. FIZZY CRISTAL

races.name: Download The Racecourse App Raceday Ready Handicap
races.verdict:
ICE SHOW was much improved on the back of an 8-week absence when opening her account over 7f here 10 days ago. Remaining low mileage and in excellent hands, she appeals as the type to build on that and earns the vote to follow up. Ey Up He's A Star, recent C&D winner Whiskey Pete and Amarachi head up the dangers, with Rugby Union not dismissed lightly either.

  1. ICE SHOW
  2. EY UP HE'S A STAR
  3. WHISKEY PETE (IRE)

races.name: Get Raceday Ready Handicap
races.verdict:
An open race can go the way of CRIMINAL SHORE who is well treated at present. Abduction is another running from a handy mark but may have to settle for second, ahead of Havana Rum who is trying this trip for the first time.

  1. CRIMINAL SHORE (IRE)
  2. ABDUCTION (FR)
  3. HAVANA RUM (IRE)

races.name: Free Digital Racecard At raceday-ready.com Handicap
races.verdict:
PIPERSTOWN was in great form on the all-weather earlier in the season and may prove the answer returning in this low-grade handicap. It would be no surprise to see Why Because bouncing back with the hood back on, while Phoenix Beach is on an attractive mark if on a going day again.

  1. PIPERSTOWN (IRE)
  2. WHY BECAUSE (IRE)
  3. PHOENIX BEACH (IRE)

races.name: Richard Davis Memorial Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
ONEHUNDREDNEIGHTY should go on improving over fences and can make it 2-2 in this sphere. Rockvale is up 8 lb for his Southwell romp and can go well again now he's got his head in front. Jimmyjeroo returns with his yard in good form and could be in the hunt if ready to go.

  1. ONEHUNDREDNEIGHTY (IRE)
  2. ROCKVALE (IRE)
  3. JIMMYJEROO

races.name: CopyBet For Champions League Profit Boosts Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
A point background suggests SONYOURASTAR should take to fences and he's selected to gain compensation for his near miss over hurdles here last month. Ballynaheer won 4 times last season and his latest Fontwell second shows he's resumed in good form. Moonlightinthepark may benefit from this longer trip and is next on the list.

  1. SONYOURASTAR (IRE)
  2. BALLYNAHEER (IRE)
  3. SAINT ARION (IRE)

races.name: CopyBet Follow Us On X Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
A recent C&D outing should have set up KALLY DES BRUYERES nicely for this and he can show he's still on a favourable mark. Alex Hales has his team in great nick so the returning Away For The Night may provide the chief threat. A point win suggests Double Indemnity may take to fences and he's next on the list.

  1. KALLY DES BRUYERES (FR)
  2. AWAY FOR THE NIGHT (IRE)
  3. DOUBLE INDEMNITY (IRE)

races.name: Paul Ferguson's Jumpers To Follow Novices' Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
POTTERS CHARM took his form over hurdles to a smart level last season, comfortably winning a Grade 2 at Fontwell early this year, and he is fancied to make a successful chasing debut with his yard enjoying a most productive spell. He gets the vote ahead of Jupiter des Mottes, who isn't taken lightly on first start for Dan Skelton.

  1. POTTERS CHARM (IRE)
  2. JUPITER DES MOTTES (FR)
  3. GLEN TO GLEN (IRE)

races.name: FBC Manby Bowdler Mares' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
MIGHTY FLEUR was on a roll when last seen in the summer, easily winning a handicap chase at Uttoxeter, and she could be up to landing the 4-timer if picking up where she left off. Broomfield Aderra is very interesting switched to fences on her return for Dan Skelton, while Best Women and Sweet Caryline are also in the mix.

  1. MIGHTY FLEUR
  2. BROOMFIELD ADERRA (IRE)
  3. BEST WOMEN (IRE)

races.name: PJ Nicholls KGM Korea Genuinely Made Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
The marked drop back in trip shouldn't trouble KYKOROCK and he can make it 4-5 over fences on his return. Authoceltic could be the danger.

  1. KYKOROCK (FR)
  2. AUTHOCELTIC (FR)
  3. SIAM PARK (IRE)

races.name: CopyBet Overnight Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
AXEL BLEUE is yet to run a bad race at Worcester and can land a third C&D handicap of the campaign, still looking on a fair mark having finished with running left at Uttoxeter last time. Big Cadillac and Island Bridge are a couple of interesting runners going chasing for the first time.

  1. AXEL BLEUE
  2. BIG CADILLAC (IRE)
  3. ISLAND BRIDGE (IRE)

races.name: Roscommon Racecourse (C & G) Maiden
races.verdict:
RESURGENCE went close at Navan before things failed to go to plan on handicap debut at Listowel, but he remains relatively unexposed and is taken to make the breakthrough back in maiden company in first-time cheekpieces. State of Wyoming caught the eye staying on at the Curragh a fortnight ago and may progress again in a visor, while Karrygrant sets the standard but looks vulnerable to improvers.

  1. RESURGENCE (IRE)
  2. STATE OF WYOMING (IRE)
  3. KARRYGRANT (IRE)

races.name: Guinness Handicap
races.verdict:
Successful on 2 of his first 3 starts this season, LA LA LUCRATIVE has been holding his form well since and he is taken to resume winning ways back at the scene of his latest victory. The main danger could be Mercurial, whose best effort of the season came when third here on his penultimate outing, with Earls completing the shortlist.

  1. LA LA LUCRATIVE (IRE)
  2. MERCURIAL (IRE)
  3. EARLS (IRE)

races.name: Roscommon Racecourse On Facebook Handicap (0-60) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
ALEX BELARDO can have a line put through his Down Royal effort 14 days ago where he endured a nightmare passage and looks worth chancing now back on his last winning mark and returned to this level. Ella's Gold was caught a bit too far back last time, but ran well at Navan in August and could prove the main danger if reverting to more positive tactics here. Buttermere Ridge kept on when third at Listowel and has a chance if in the same form.

  1. ALEX BELARDO (IRE)
  2. ELLA'S GOLD (IRE)
  3. BUTTERMERE RIDGE (IRE)

races.name: Roscommon Racecourse On Facebook Handicap (0-60) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
MOGWLI is firmly in the veteran stage of his career but took a step back in the right direction when fourth at Thurles on Thursday and looks worth chancing from a basement mark. Cisterna is hard to rely on but has already won over C&D this year and looks the main danger, while Draiocht is also respected from a good mark.

  1. MOGWLI (IRE)
  2. CISTERNA (IRE)
  3. DRAIOCHT (IRE)

races.name: Boyle Maiden
races.verdict:
TEOEST continues to progress with experience and chased home a subsequent winner at Listowel last time. He meets several of these on much better terms than he would in a handicap and is taken to get off the mark. Saliba should benefit from the step back up in trip and might be the main danger if belatedly building on his Punchestown second, while Big Cypress was unlucky not to win at Gowran and is also firmly in the mix.

  1. TEOEST (IRE)
  2. SALIBA (IRE)
  3. BIG CYPRESS

races.name: Roscommon Rated Race
races.verdict:
BACK STRAIGHT found listed company too much at Killarney a week ago but had opened his account in a maiden previously and can bounce back returned to a more suitable level. Minella Rockett completed a hat-trick, including a win over hurdles, and remained in top form when narrowly denied at Punchestown last time, so looks the main threat, while God of Power is respected on the pick of his efforts this year despite struggling in handicap company last time.

  1. BACK STRAIGHT
  2. MINELLA ROCKETT (IRE)
  3. GOD OF POWER (IRE)

races.name: On-Course Vets Handicap
races.verdict:
LAUDERDALE KING has taken his form up a notch on his last 2 starts, making it back-to-back wins when scoring with a bit in hand at Listowel, and he is fancied to land the hat-trick. Next best could be Flying Fortress who has gone close at this course the last twice, with Matt Connor and Unfold also considered.

  1. LAUDERDALE KING (IRE)
  2. FLYING FORTRESS
  3. MATT CONNOR (IRE)

races.name: Thank You For Your Support Handicap (0-60)
races.verdict:
BALLAGHKEEN is less exposed than most she meets here and can defy a penalty to follow up last week's Navan win. Royal Belief, Deluca Chop and Autocrat are also shortlisted in a decent race for the grade.

  1. BALLAGHKEEN (IRE)
  2. ROYAL BELIEF (IRE)
  3. DELUCA CHOP (FR)

races.name: Prix Colonel Jochaud Du Plessix Chase
Prix Jacques Rossi (Prix Jules Morgan) Handicap

Prix De La Porte Chaumont - Attele
Prix Du Pont De La Tournelle - Attele
Prix Agrial - Yearly La Maison.fr - Attele
